Available Floor Plans at The Chocolate Works

Explore our pet-friendly, luxury 1- and 2-bedroom apartments at one of Old City’s best apartment buildings – The Chocolate Works. Enjoy must-have in-unit amenities and community features, including large closets, individual washers and dryers, on-site fitness center, and 24-hour professional maintenance. Fall in love with the high, lofty ceilings and warm, neutral finishes in each of our Old City apartment homes. Private balconies and terraces are available for select rental units. Take a look at our floor plans below, review our application requirements, and schedule an in-person tour today.
